author: Jojo

short: Try to lift Thor's mighty hammer!
description: Port of Kreusada's mjolnir, which was removed from Kreusada-Cogs. Try to lift Thor's hammer and climb the leaderboard. Reads the lift counts the original cog saved.
install_msg: Unload and uninstall Kreusada's mjolnir before loading this; everyone's lift counts carry over.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores how many times each user has lifted the hammer, by user ID.
